subject.title: refactor(meeting-bot): extract browser meeting-bot core behind MeetingPlatformAdapter

question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/meeting-runtime` become a supported public plugin contract now, before a second meeting-platform adapter validates its 81 exported symbols and 32 callables?
rationale: Repository policy treats plugin API additions as compatibility-sensitive, and code inspection cannot determine whether maintainers intentionally accept this broad permanent contract based on one implementation.

options.title: Keep it private first
options.body: Land the extraction through an internal or bundled-only facade and defer the public SDK subpath until a second adapter validates and narrows the contract.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Explicitly accept the current broad API as supported and own future compatibility, documentation, and deprecation obligations for external plugins.

options.title: Review with the second adapter
options.body: Hold or split this PR so the proposed Teams adapter can demonstrate the shared requirements in the same design review.

recommendation.title: Keep it private first
recommendation.body: Land the extraction through an internal or bundled-only facade and defer the public SDK subpath until a second adapter validates and narrows the contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent merged consolidation history and current ownership make steipete the best available person to confirm the intended public boundary.
